---
address: indonesia.geo.postalCodePrefix
description: The 473 three-digit prefixes that occur in real Indonesian postal codes. An Indonesian kode pos is 5 digits: digit 1 is the zone (1 Jakarta, 2 northern Sumatra, 3 southern Sumatra, 4 Banten and West Java, 5 Central Java and Yogyakarta, 6 East Java, 7 Kalimantan, 8 Bali and Nusa Tenggara, 9 Sulawesi/Maluku/Papua), digits 2-3 the regency or city, digit 4 the district and digit 5 the village. Derived from a 10,671-code postal dataset covering all 38 provinces; indonesia.geo.postalCode appends the last two digits.
